query: Which cross-species homology frameworks (CoCoMac, Allen Atlas mappings, registration pipelines) will we use to map tracer pathways to human anatomy, and how will we quantify and propagate homology uncertainty?

response.query: Which cross-species homology frameworks (CoCoMac, Allen Atlas mappings, registration pipelines) will we use to map tracer pathways to human anatomy, and how will we quantify and propagate homology uncertainty?
response.answer: We will use CoCoMac and Allen Atlas mappings to map tracer pathways to human anatomy, quantifying and propagating homology uncertainty through statistical models.
